programmes.d: Chiana purchases an abused slave girl from a passing trading ship.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E22 - Family Ties
programmes.d: With death approaching in the form of Peacekeeper search parties, those aboard Moya say their final goodbyes, and share a last feast together.
Scorpius takes Crichton, D'Argo and Rygel to an advanced training camp where students learn mental discipline.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E1 - Mind The Baby
programmes.d: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them. Their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.
The women of Moya stumble upon a secret meeting that will change the future of the Uncharted Territories.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E2 - Vitas Mortis
programmes.d: D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive.
The crew travels through a wormhole to Earth in 1985; when Crichton discovers that his father is about to fly the doomed ride with the Challenger, he tries to turn back time.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E3 - Taking The Stone
programmes.d: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by reckless thrill seekers who play dangerous and life-threatening games.
Crichton and Scorpius travel through a wormhole to a mixed-up version of Moya in search of abducted Aeryn.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E4 - Crackers Don't Matter
programmes.d: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya. The crew welcomes him on board, but soon almost everyone is acting paranoid.
Moya's crew traces Aeryn to a freighter at a scarecrow border station; Noranti releases a deadly, contagious virus to keep the vessel in dock.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E5 - The Way We Weren't
programmes.d: Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot. After seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya
Moya's crew travels to a heavily guarded Scarran base where Scorpius is being tortured for critical wormhole information.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E6 - Picture If You Will
programmes.d: Chiana buys a picture in a store, which is more than it seems. The picture changes and shows Chiana what will happen to her.
After thwarting Crichton's escape plan, Scorpius denies he is a Scarran spy.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E7 - Home On The Remains
programmes.d: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn seems to have a tolerance for the spores.
With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans must travel to Earth through a wormhole as those flowers grow there; with Pilot's help, Crichton tries to collapse the wormhole leading back to Earth.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E8 - Dream A Little Dream
programmes.d: While waiting for Moya to pick their Transport Pod, Zhaan tells Crichton of Moya's adventures after the Gammak base was destroyed.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E9 - Out Of Their Minds
programmes.d: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast makes it through and causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.
Astronaut John Crichton is accidentally hurled across a universe and thrust into the middle of a space battle after his ship is swallowed by a wormhole.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons
programmes.d: A strange globe appears on Moya, sucking in Crichton and duplicating him creating two additional people.
Giant space-cockroaches invade the ship, infest the corridors and clog the vents, causing a rise in temperature which endangers Aeryn.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programmes.d: On a planet about to crown its new monarch. The problem is the Princess cannot ascend unless she finds a genetically compatible mate.
A sensual alien seduces men to obtain a weapon of mass destruction; Crichton experiences mental flashes of the future.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programmes.d: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter the crown princess, or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.
For trade with the Tavleks, Rygel (John Eccleston, Jonathan Hardy) takes a crystal essential to Moya's survival.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programmes.d: John Crichton faces eighty years as a statue. That is, until the Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into a vat of acid.
Crichton and a female Peacekeeper Tech, left behind by Captain Crais, join forces to save Moya when a race of scavengers attacks.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
programmes.d: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.
Crichton must free D'Argo from the influence of a thought-altering plant.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
programmes.d: Crichton has returned to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth all this time? People from his past and present appear.
Moya crash-lands on a planet to avoid being traced by the Peacekeepers; Crichton soon realizes that he has become an alien to the inhabitants.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E16 - The Locket
programmes.d: A temporal distortion traps Aeryn and John on a planet's surface, where they live out the rest of their lives.
When an evil sorcerer engineers a deadly contest between Crichton and Crais, Zhaan must rouse a dark power within herself to rescue Crichton.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
programmes.d: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.
When the crew seeks out a genetic scientist who can provide them with charts to their homeworlds, the scientist secretly injects Aeryn with Pilot's DNA.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
programmes.d: A Nebari group comes aboard Moya and attempts to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan
programmes.d: D'Argo finally gets a lead on his son, Jothee. He will do anything to get him back, but Jothee will be sold as a slave.
After D'Argo suffers a mishap during a maintenance check on Moya, he is tormented by flashbacks; the ship strikes out at the crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These
programmes.d: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo anxiously waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.
While gathering data to re-create a wormhole, Crichton and Aeryn are confronted by wolflike bounty hunters in search of Moya's crew.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programmes.d: The crew is going to break into the depository to free Crichton. Crichton is being tortured for wormhole technology.
An invisible net controlled by Zenetan pirates captures Crichton and Aeryn's transport pod and threatens to snare the Moya as well.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy
programmes.d: Wealthy from their bank heist, Moya's crew heads straight to meet with Diagnosan Tocot, a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns.
When Zhaan tries to aid in curing Tahleen's madness, Tahleen betrays her and reveals Zhaan's dark side.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death
programmes.d: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, left with his head open on an operating table, while Scorpius attempts to avoid discovery.
Crichton stumbles upon the planet of Acquara, an Earth-like paradise where no mechanical devices seem to function after landing.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers
programmes.d: Moya docks at a commerce station so the crew can spend some of their money. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.
Mental cleansing changes a Peacekeeper, who once tormented Rygel, into a servile being; with Ben Browder, Gigi Edgley and Tiriel Mora.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E3 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programmes.d: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.
Crichton travels through a wormhole that greatly affects Earth, where the entire crew is subjected to intense testing and imprisonment.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E4 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programmes.d: The crew works out a way of getting free from the other ship and out of the wormhole.
Moya tries to starburst to prove to the crew that she still can; it goes slightly wrong though and she gets stuck in starburst, and splits into several different dimensions.

programmes.t: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E5 - Different Destinations
programmes.d: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool are back in time where they alter the timeline.
Peacekeeper commandos board the ship after a fuel leak and join the Moya's crew in battle against a deadly virus.
